cohort: The study involved 1670 postpartum women over 18 years old, divided into groups with and without pre-existing hypertension.
finding: Women with pre-existing hypertension had a higher chance of gestational diabetes, hypertensive disorders of pregnancy, and preterm birth.
mod_finding: Women with pre-existing hypertension had a higher incidence of cesarean section.
gest_age: Infants of mothers with pre-existing hypertension had lower gestational age at birth.
birth_weight: Infants of mothers with pre-existing hypertension had lower birth weight.
